rules.new_brand: Cashier may type any brand. Receipt prints it as typed. It stays on that item only until a manager or owner adds it to the pick-list from the review queue. The brand box suggests typed brands still waiting for approval.
rules.no_category_fits: Picker offers 'Not in the list'. Cashier types the product word (minimum 3 characters). It prints as typed as the category word. Item is pending review. Only the owner creates categories.
rules.new_phone_model: Cashier may type a phone model that is not in the list. It prints as typed, stays on that item, and joins the list when a manager or the owner approves it.

changelog.change: Four word-less categories, plus Smartwatches, became parents with 13 sellable children
changelog.detail: Memory card, Flash drive; Selfie stick, Ring light, Tripod; OTG adapter, AUX adapter, Splitter; Mouse, Keyboard, USB hub; Smartwatch, Band. Every sellable category now has a category word, so no receipt line can print blank. The inline kind lists and the kind_or_word token are retired. The top level still shows 19 tiles.

changelog.change: Phone models became a two-level pick-list used by pouches, screen protectors and batteries
changelog.detail: 19 families, 466 models drafted from public names; verify at the shelf walk. A missing model can be typed at the counter; it waits for approval like a typed brand.

changelog.change: "Made by" replaces Brand on pouches, protectors and batteries, defaulting to No brand
changelog.detail: The phone's maker now comes from the phone model. Apple and Samsung are no longer shown first there, because on pouches the owner uses them to mean the phone.
It is a description, so "iphone charger" and "iphone" became search words on the two Lightning connector pairs. DataCable stays a brand: it is printed on the packaging.

changelog.change: PRO moved from Brands to Models
changelog.detail: Pro is an earpods product (No brand, Earbuds), separate from Pro 5s. J7 and car mp3 s8 stay under Car chargers and print as typed.

changelog.change: Wireless chargers keep the shared wattage list
changelog.detail: The example now uses 20W; 15W was never in the list.

changelog.change: Every entry has a permanent ID, and the file has a schema_version
changelog.detail: IDs never change when a name changes, so a later catalogue pull can tell a rename from a new entry.

changelog.change: The adapters' inline connector values became the named list adapter_connectors
Units are written without a space, and printed values use title case
changelog.detail: 0.25m, 1m, 1.5m, 2m, 3m; Wallet Flip; Tempered Glass. Search treats "1 m" and "1m" as the same.

changelog.change: Mouse and Keyboard gained a Connectivity facet
changelog.detail: Wired, Wireless or Bluetooth, printed before the word: "Wireless Mouse".

changelog.change: Cases print as "Pouch", with the pouch type before the word
changelog.detail: "iPhone 11 Silicone Pouch". The category is now "Phone pouches and covers"; "case", "phone case" and "cover" are search words. Screen protectors follow the same order ("Tecno Spark 20 Tempered Glass Screen Protector"); confirm with the owner.

changelog.change: "earpods" became a search word for Earbuds
Each category has a drill order for the tap-through tiles
changelog.detail: Proposed defaults; the cashier timing test at G1 confirms them.

changelog.change: The 127 stored generated lines became 5 generator rules
changelog.detail: The same 127 shapes are offered at the counter and an item is created on its first sale, so there is no prune review at setup.
